build_cfg_graph: build a CFG graph with configurable depth, symbols, and degree constraints using CFG_Config
generate_cfg_data: generate synthetic context-free grammar data sequences from a CFG_Config instance using generate_onedata
load_cfg_from_file: load a previously saved CFG graph from a JSON file using CFG_Config.from_graph
solve_cfg_dp: solve context-free grammar parsing with dynamic programming using solve_dp_noneq to find minimum edits
compute_cfg_probabilities: compute conditional token probabilities for a sequence under a CFG using solve_dp_prob_highprecision
